description: Save the finished work for one play (copy, code or research, in markdown) onto the founder's gtm.help board as Ready to review. Use this whenever you have written the work for a play, instead of leaving it only in chat. It never marks the play done and never publishes anything.

agent_name.description: Your name, e.g. Claude or Cursor, shown on the board.

deliverable.description: The finished work in markdown, ready to copy and use.

kind.description: copy_kit (copy/emails/posts), code (markup/files) or audit (research). Defaults to copy_kit.

name: submit_play_draft
title: Submit finished work for a play
